scientific_question: Does a continuous objective PRE tactical-profile scalar add stable conditional placement information beyond competition_score without altering Stage-1 winner probabilities?

baseline.name: S0_SCORE_ONLY_STANDARD_PL
baseline.stage2_logits: beta * competition_score after actual stage1 removal
baseline.stage3_logits: beta * competition_score after actual stage1 and stage2 removal

tactical_profile.formula: ((nige + makuri) - (sashi + mark)) / (nige + makuri + sashi + mark) when denominator > 0; exactly 0 when all four explicitly observed PRE counts are 0

candidate.name: S0_OBJECTIVE_TACTICAL_PROFILE_CONDITIONAL_PL_V1
candidate.stage2_logits: beta * competition_score + gamma * tactical_profile after actual stage1 removal
candidate.stage3_logits: beta * competition_score + gamma * tactical_profile after actual stage1 and stage2 removal

fit_objective.equivalence_note: Because Stage-1 is invariant to gamma, optimization is equivalent to minimizing mean L2+L3 on the fit set.

fit_set.selection: whole accessible meeting/day blocks in chronological KDreams source order

evaluation_holdout.selection: whole accessible meeting/day blocks in chronological KDreams source order excluding all fit-set meeting identities

invariance_checks: winner_log_loss exactly equal to untouched S0 within numerical tolerance
winner_brier exactly equal to untouched S0 within numerical tolerance

required_contract_checks: frozen gamma not refit on evaluation
no RESULT/PAYOUT/odds/human forecast used as feature
advancement_rule.uncertainty_for_wider_replication: 95pct race-cluster bootstrap CI for candidate-minus-S0 ordered_top3_log_loss must have upper bound < 0; otherwise at most PROMISING_NO_ADVANCE_TO_WIDER_REPLICATION

failure_interpretation.eval_failure_next_direction: Only after this test, consider a separately prespecified objective bank/course interaction or field-size structural model.
